JENNIFER 2/17-3/9 Rob Bresnahan n/a n/a Jennifer, a nurse for 30 years, says that 
hospitals are stretched to the brink. Medicaid 
saves lives  but Bresnahan voted to cut 
Medicaid and for huge tax breaks for 
corporations.  He sold stock in Med providers 
before voting to cut it. Now PA hospitals may 
have to close, which would be catastrophic. 
Bresnahan puts profits before 
Pennsylvanians. Phone # provided to call 
Rob’s office. 
GRACE 3/17-4/6 Rob Bresnahan n/a n/a Grace has a chronic disease since she was 13 
years old. Her family was drowning in debt 
until she could get on Medicaid. Now Rob 
Bresnahan voted to cut Medicaid to give 
huge tax breaks to corporations and 
billionaires.  He put profits before 
Pennsylvanians.    Rob’s office # provided at 
end of ad. 
STEVE 5/26- Rob Bresnahan n/a n/a Steve had prostate cancer. He relies on Medicare.  
Bresnahan voted to cut Medicare to give tax 
breaks to billionaires AND voted to stop allowing 
Medicare to negotiate rates and lower prices for 
cancer drugs.  Tell Congressman Bres. to stop 
cutting our health care!
